changelog.name: MACsposed v1.3.0
changelog.body: After a long pause in development, we're back! 🥳 MACsposed 1.3.0 adds support for Android 16 and Android 17, and migrates to LSPosed API 101. An LSPosed build with API 101 support is required; this version is not compatible with API 100-only frameworks. **If you are unable to use an LSPosed version that supports API 101, then you must stay on MACsposed v1.2.5.** Other changes introduced with this release include: - Long-pressing the Quick Settings tile will now open MACsposed instead of showing the app info screen. - An issue that prevented setting the physical MAC address from working correctly on some devices when disabling the MAC address override hook has been corrected. - A user interface bug that would intermittently cause the app to incorrectly report that the module is disabled has been resolved. - A bug that would intermittently cause the app to crash when attempting to launch it has been fixed. - Devices that use the MediaTek MT6877 chipset should no longer fail to apply MAC address changes. This fix was tested with a limited set of users. If your device uses MediaTek MT6877 and continues to fail, please open a ticket on the [MACsposed issue tracker](https://github.com/DavidBerdik/MACsposed/issues). - When a subscription is suspended due to a payment issue, the app now shows guidance to update your payment method in the Google Play Store instead of offering additional purchase options.

changelog.name: MACsposed v1.2.5
changelog.body: This release fixes an issue that prevented MACsposed from working properly on certain devices.

changelog.name: MACsposed v1.2.4
changelog.body: This release fixes an issue that was introduced in MACsposed 1.2.3 that caused MAC address change attempts to fail despite previously working with MACsposed 1.2.2. ------------ **Changelog for MACsposed 1.2.3:** MACsposed 1.2.3 adds support for Android 15 and includes the following additional changes: - Access to the Settings panel is now always available to allow users to change the "Language" and "Dark Mode" settings. Previously, the Settings panel was only available when root access was granted and the module was enabled in LSPosed. - Corrections to the Arabic translation provided by @mast3rz3ro. - An issue that caused attempts to change the MAC address to fail on certain devices has been corrected. - MACsposed will now automatically detect the interface name used by the device for WiFi access. Previously, MACsposed only supported devices that use `wlan0` as the name for the network interface.

changelog.name: MACsposed v1.2.2
changelog.body: MACsposed 1.2.2 adds an Arabic translation provided by @mast3rz3ro. ------------ **Changelog for MACsposed 1.2.0:** MACsposed 1.2.0 is here! This major update introduces integrated support for MAC address spoofing which eliminates the need to rely on third party spoofing applications. Although third party spoofing tools are no longer required, they are still supported if you wish to continue using them. Other changes introduced with this release include: - A built-in user interface with support for Material You theming and dark mode. - A redesigned app icon for consistency with the new UI's design language. - Support for changing how the app behaves when enabling the MAC address override. - Support for restoring a spoofed MAC address on boot. - Support for disabling logging of attempts by Android to change the MAC address in the LSPosed Manager. - A Hindi translation of the user interface provided by @99keshav99. With this release, MACsposed is shifting to a paid licensing model and requires an in-app purchase of a subscription or a lifetime license to unlock its functionality.

changelog.name: MACsposed v1.1.6
changelog.body: This release adds in-app instructions for how to use the module after it has been enabled.

changelog.name: MACsposed v1.1.5
changelog.body:
MACsposed 1.1.5 fixes a compilation issue that caused the release builds of MACsposed 1.1.4 to not work properly.

Changelog for MACsposed 1.1.4: This release adds support for Android 14. As of this release, use of the LSPosed variant of Xposed is now mandatory. Other Xposed variants will not work.

changelog.name: MACsposed v1.1.4
changelog.body: This release adds support for Android 14. As of this release, use of the LSPosed variant of Xposed is now mandatory. Other Xposed variants will not work.

changelog.name: MACsposed v1.1.3
changelog.body: This release adds in-app instructions describing how to configure and use the app. The instructions are accessible via the "MACsposed" app entry in your app drawer. Once the app is activated in Xposed, the app will automatically be removed from your app drawer to reduce clutter. If you later disable the module or uninstall Xposed, the icon will be readded to your app drawer when you next attempt to interact with the MACsposed quick settings tile. Additionally, a bug which caused the app to crash when not activated in Xposed was fixed.

changelog.name: MACsposed v1.1.2
changelog.body: This release fixes a logging bug that was inadvertently introduced as part of the changes made to MACsposed v1.1.1. The bug caused log entries made when MACsposed either allowed or blocked a MAC address change to not be written properly.

changelog.name: MACsposed v1.1.1
changelog.body: This release fixes an issue with the MACsposed tile not being automatically added to the Quick Settings Panel for some devices on Android 13. Additionally, this release improves the method used for blocking Android's MAC address randomizer.

changelog.name: MACsposed v1.1.0
changelog.body: MACsposed now supports Android 13! This release also includes a new app icon.

changelog.name: MACsposed v1.0.1
changelog.body: The initial release of MACsposed only supported Android 12L by accident. This release corrects that error so that the module may be used on Android 12 as well.

readme: # MACsposed Historically, setting a custom MAC address on Android was very easy for rooted users. Starting with Android 12, however, Google's implementation of MAC address randomization has made it impossible, as the MAC address is always changed when the network state is altered. If you have encountered this problem, then you need MACsposed! MACsposed is an Xposed module that blocks the MAC address randomizer on Android 12 through 17 and provides a user-friendly interface for spoofing your MAC address. Do you have other spoofing tools that you would prefer to use instead? No problem! Simply enable MACsposed and go back to using your preferred address spoofing tool. MACsposed is not free software and requires an in-app purchase of a subscription or a lifetime license to unlock its functionality. **⚠️ WARNING:** MACsposed is intended for rooted devices running Android 12 through 17 and requires Xposed. The required Xposed variant to use is an LSPosed release with API 101 support; this module is not compatible with API 100-only releases. Other Xposed variants will not work. Additionally, this module cannot be guaranteed to work on all devices. In the worst case, it can cause a bootloop. Use at your own risk.
